notes.title: Patchnote - Build 2.9.1
notes.content:
Changelog for new build 2.9.1.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[i]DLC fixes[/i]

[list]
[*] UI no longer reports that incorrect events have previously happened.
[*] The first text shown in a new game is now also localised.
[/list]

[i]Master game fixes[/i]

[list]
[*] German language has all its characters back into the game.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that could cause a softlock for players in the second scene of the game.
[*] Credits now display correctly.
[*] Fixed a voice line for Gerda's diary that was wrong within the main game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4 - Version 2.8.4
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]

[b]DLC[/b]

[list]
[*] Our DLC "Liva's Story" is now available!
[*] Updates in save system to separate main game files from the DLC’s.
[*] Updates in the achievements, and additional end game stats.
[/list]

[b]Menu navigation and Flow[/b]

[list]
[*] New menus, UI and screens to display the possibility to get information on our DLC “Liva’s Story”
[*] Updates in splash screen
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[b]Animations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Animations improvements on most characters in all scenes.
[/list]

[b]Scenes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Animation improvements on individual scenes
[*] Terrain and scene art improvements
[*] Some UI improvements in scenes
[*] Changes to improve display of the Credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.8 is now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
You will find below the changes that we have implemented in this latest patch. 

[list]
[*] The game is no longer unresponsive when players interact in specific order with NPCs in the market sequence on Friday, 3pm
[*] Improved stability
[*] Improved the display system when launching the game, in case of specific monitors (ultrawide screen or 4:3).
[/list]

notes.title: Gerda: A Flame in Winter - Note de Patch 2 (11 Oct. 2022)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
You will find below a non-exhaustive list of things we have implemented in this patch.
 
[b]New features – PC & Nintendo Switch [/b]
•	Added a better animation system that fixes most of the encountered issues
•	Added better-looking loading screens between sequences
•	Added a dyslexia friendly text display option

[b]New features – PC [/b]
•	Added possibility to disable Controllers from the Settings menu
•	Added the possibility to choose between 2 Graphics Quality options (High to Low)
 
[b]Bugfixes – PC & Nintendo Switch  [/b]
•	General balancing 
•	Improved stability 
•	Various texts and UI adjustments 
•	The game is no longer unresponsive after interacting with Reinhardt and the marketeer in the market sequence on Friday, 3pm

[b]Platform specific items – PC [/b]
•	Fixed various issues related to mouse cursor & clicks. 
•	Fixed an issue with progress bar for Steam achievements about the secrets and facts.
•	Fixed issues with corrupt saves (rare cases where the screen stayed black after launch).
Should you encounter issues or have any question, please check our dedicated FAQ or contact us if you need further assistance. 

DON’T NOD & PortaPlay

[hr][/hr]

Bonjour à toutes et tous.
Veuillez trouver ci-dessous une liste non-exhaustive de ce que nous avons implémenté dans ce nouveau patch.
 
[b]Nouvelles fonctionnalités – PC & Nintendo Switch [/b]
•	Ajout d'un meilleur système d'animation pour corriger la plupart des problèmes rencontrés
•	Ajout de nouveaux écrans de chargement entre les scènes
•	Ajout d'une option d'affichage des textes adaptée à la dyslexie.

[b]Nouvelles fonctionnalités – PC[/b]
•	Ajout de la possibilité de désactiver les manettes dans les options
•	Ajout de la possibilité de passer la qualité graphique en "basse" pour des configurations PC plus modestes.

[b]Corrections de bugs – PC & Nintendo Switch  [/b]
•	Le jeu n'est plus bloqué si les joueurs interagissent trop vite avec Reinhardt dans la scène du vendredi au marché, à 15h
•	Stabilité améliorée 
•	Ajustements des textes et interfaces dans certaines langues
•	Equilibrage amélioré.

[b]Problèmes spécifiques à une plateforme – PC [/b]
•	Correction de problèmes relatifs au curseur ou au clic souris 
•	Correction de la barre de progression des succès Steam pour les secrets et les faits historiques
•	Correction de cas de sauvegardes corrompues (écran noir après lancement du jeu).
Si toutefois vous rencontrez un problème ou souhaitez nous poser une question, veuillez consulter notre FAQ ou contactez-nous en cas de besoin. 

DON'T NOD & PortaPlay
